description: This file defines a PHP class BedrockAgentClient within the Aws\BedrockAgent namespace. The class acts as a client to interact with Amazon Bedrock's Agent services, providing method stubs for various API operations, including create, delete, get, list, update, and associate actions related to agents, knowledge bases, prompts, and flows.
